analysis_note: Post-audit corrective sensitivity rerun after inspecting the original 2026 results. The original GitHub-containing results are superseded as primary evidence. Model selection still uses only 2025-origin labels available by 2026-01-01 UTC; hyperparameters are frozen and no 2026 tuning is performed. The 2026 period is not an untouched confirmatory test.

raw_series_quality.dl: artifact-only PyPI downloads; interpretation and measurement-boundary caveats retained
raw_series_quality.release: release metadata available at historical feature cutoff
raw_series_quality.gh: observed capture is incomplete or unvalidated; all GH predictors excluded on all dates
raw_series_quality.research: not reviewed for point-in-time eligibility; excluded

protocol.refit: monthly; train once at the first eligible forecast cutoff of each month
protocol.tuning: none; original fixed hyperparameters retained, no tuning on previously examined 2026 outcomes
protocol.evaluation_status: post-audit sensitivity rerun of previously examined 2026, not an untouched confirmatory test
protocol.training_median_baseline: constant median target_log_growth from the current fold's available training labels only; MAE-optimal training constant before common physical lower-bound clipping
protocol.model_selection: lowest MAE among 2025-origin validation labels available by 2026-01-01 UTC; exact ties use higher median weekly Spearman then model name; full 2025 metrics are descriptive and later labels do not influence selection
protocol.training_rule: label_available_at <= model training cutoff and complete historical coverage
protocol.preprocessing: median imputation plus missing indicators and standard scaling fit on each training fold only
protocol.prediction_constraint: growth is bounded below by -ln(1+past-eight-week median) so downloads cannot be negative

target_semantics.baseline_window: median artifact downloads in feature weeks t-7 through t
target_semantics.outcome_window: median artifact downloads in eight full weeks t+2 through t+9
target_semantics.sustained_label: at least six outcome weeks exceed 1.10 times B_i,t
target_semantics.precision_at_5_definition: For each week with at least five eligible tools, rank predicted growth descending and average target_sustained among the first five; then average across weeks. Ties use tool_id ascending. This is not top-five overlap.
target_semantics.spearman_definition: Median of defined cross-sectional weekly Spearman correlations. A constant prediction or target has undefined correlation, not zero.
target_semantics.relative_change_note: expm1(prediction_log_growth) is the change in 1+median downloads. Use predicted_median_downloads / baseline_median_downloads - 1 for an exact download percentage only when the baseline is positive.
target_semantics.forecast_timing_note: Latest forecasts are generated now from the latest eligible feature week. Their training cutoff is the actual as-of time. Check target-window bounds and outcome_period_has_started rather than treating them as backdated forecasts.
